items.source: Generates the build-info.properties file in the configured destination.
items.translation: 生成 build-info.properties` 文件到配置的 destination。

items.source: Returns the properties that will be included in the build-info.properties file.
items.translation: 返回将包含在 build-info.properties` 文件中的 properties。

items.source: Returns the LayeredSpec.ApplicationSpec that controls the layers to which application classes and resources belong.
items.translation: 返回控制应用程序类和资源所属分层的LayeredSpec.ApplicationSpec。

items.source: Returns a CopySpec that can be used to add content to the BOOT-INF directory of the jar.
items.translation: 返回一个CopySpec，可用于向 jar 的BOOT-INF目录添加内容。

items.source: Returns the DockerSpec.DockerRegistrySpec that configures authentication to the builder registry.
items.translation: 返回用于配置构建器注册表认证的DockerSpec.DockerRegistrySpec。

items.source: Returns the LayeredSpec.DependenciesSpec that controls the layers to which dependencies belong.
items.translation: 返回用于控制依赖所属层的 LayeredSpec.DependenciesSpec。

items.source: Returns the DockerSpec.DockerRegistrySpec that configures authentication to the publishing registry.
items.translation: 返回用于配置发布仓库认证的 DockerSpec.DockerRegistrySpec。

items.source: Returns the build.artifact property.
items.translation: 返回 build.artifact` 属性。

items.source: Returns the date that will be used as the Created date of the image.
items.translation: 返回将用作图像的Created 日期的日期。

items.source: Returns the directory to which the build-info.properties file will be written.
items.translation: 返回将写入build-info.properties文件的目录。

items.source: Returns the build.group property.
items.translation: 返回 build.group` 属性。

items.source: Returns the build.name property.
items.translation: 返回 build.name` 属性。

items.source: Returns the provided classpath, the contents of which will be included in the WEB-INF/lib-provided directory of the war.
items.translation: 返回提供的类路径，其内容将被包含在 war 的 WEB-INF/lib-provided` 目录中。

items.source: Returns the build.time property.
items.translation: 返回 build.time` 属性。

items.source: Returns the build.version property.
items.translation: 返回 build.version` 属性。

items.source: Returns the additional properties that will be included.
items.translation: 返回将包含的附加属性。

items.source: Returns the directory that contains application content in the image.
items.translation: 返回包含镜像中应用程序内容的目录。

items.source: Returns the main class of the application that is to be processed ahead-of-time.
items.translation: 返回要提前处理的应用程序的主类。

items.source: Returns the property for the archive file from which the image will be built.
items.translation: 返回用于构建镜像的归档文件的属性。

items.source: The artifact ID of the application that is to be processed ahead-of-time.
items.translation: 要提前处理的应用程序的 artifact ID。

items.source:
Returns the volume bindings that will be mounted to the container when building the
image.
items.translation: 返回构建镜像时将挂载到容器的卷绑定。

items.source: Returns the build cache that will be used when building the image.
items.translation: 返回构建镜像时将使用的构建缓存。

items.source: Returns the builder that will be used to build the image.
items.translation: 返回用于构建镜像的构建器。

items.source: Returns the buildpacks that will be used when building the image.
items.translation: 返回构建镜像时将使用的构建包。

items.source: Returns the build temporary workspace that will be used when building the image.
items.translation: 返回构建镜像时将使用的构建临时工作区。

items.source: The directory to which AOT-generated classes should be written.
items.translation: AOT 生成的类应写入的目录。

items.source:
Returns the classpath that the task will examine when resolving the main class
name.
items.translation: 返回任务在解析主类名称时将检查的类路径。

items.source: Returns the classpath roots that should be scanned for test classes to process.
items.translation: 返回应扫描以处理测试类的类路径根目录。

items.source: Returns whether caches should be cleaned before packaging.
items.translation: 返回在打包之前是否应清理缓存。

items.source:
Returns the property for the explicitly configured main class name that should be
used in favor of resolving the main class name from the classpath.
items.translation: 返回显式配置的主类名称属性，该属性应优先于从类路径解析主类名称。

items.source: Returns the Docker configuration the builder will use.
items.translation: 返回构建器将使用的 Docker 配置。

items.source: Returns the email address associated with the Docker registry username.
items.translation: 返回与 Docker 注册表用户名关联的电子邮件地址。

items.source: Returns whether the layers.idx should be included in the archive.
items.translation: 返回是否应将 layers.idx 包含在归档中。

items.source: Returns the environment that will be used when building the image.
items.translation: 返回构建镜像时将使用的环境。

items.source: Returns the names of the properties to exclude from the output.
items.translation: 返回要从输出中排除的属性名称。

items.source: The group ID of the application that is to be processed ahead-of-time.
items.translation: 要提前处理的应用程序的组 ID。

items.source: Returns the name of the image that will be built.
items.translation: 返回将要构建的镜像的名称。

items.source:
Returns the platform (os/architecture/variant) that will be used for all pulled
images.
items.translation: 返回用于所有拉取镜像的平台（操作系统/架构/变体）。

items.source:
Returns whether the JAR tools should be included as a dependency in the layered
archive.
items.translation: 返回是否应将 JAR 工具包含为分层归档的依赖项。

items.source: Returns the launch cache that will be used when building the image.
items.translation: 返回构建镜像时将使用的启动缓存。

items.source: Returns the spec that describes the layers in a layered jar.
items.translation: 返回描述分层 JAR 中各层的规范。

items.source:
Returns the order of the layers in the archive from least to most frequently
changing.
items.translation: 返回归档中图层从最少变更到最多变更的顺序。

items.source: Returns the fully-qualified name of the application's main class.
items.translation: 返回应用程序主类的完全限定名。

items.source: Returns the name of the cache.
items.translation: 返回缓存的名称。

items.source: Returns the property for whether the JVM's launch should be optimized.
items.translation: 返回是否应优化 JVM 启动的属性。

items.source:
Returns the property for the task's output file that will contain the name of the
main class.
items.translation: 返回包含主类名称的任务输出文件的属性。

items.source: Returns the password to use when authenticating to the Docker registry.
items.translation: 返回用于向 Docker 注册表进行身份验证的密码。

items.source: Whether the built image should be pushed to a registry.
items.translation: 是否应将构建的镜像推送到注册表。

items.source: Returns image pull policy that will be used when building the image.
items.translation: 返回构建镜像时将使用的镜像拉取策略。

items.source: The directory to which AOT-generated resources should be written.
items.translation: AOT 生成资源应写入的目录。

items.source: Returns the run image that will be included in the built image.
items.translation: 返回将包含在构建镜像中的运行镜像。

items.source: Returns the security options that will be applied to the builder container.
items.translation: 返回将应用于构建器容器的安全选项。

items.source: Returns the source of the cache.
items.translation: 返回缓存的源。

items.source: The directory to which AOT-generated sources should be written.
items.translation: AOT 生成源文件应写入的目录。

items.source: Returns the tags that will be created for the built image.
items.translation: 返回为构建的镜像创建的标签。

items.source: Returns the target Java version of the project (e.g.
items.translation: 返回项目的目标 Java 版本（例如

items.source: Returns the identity token to use when authenticating to the Docker registry.
items.translation: 返回用于向 Docker 注册表进行身份验证的身份令牌。

items.source: Whether to treat the builder as trusted.
items.translation: 是否将构建器视为可信。

items.source: Returns the Docker registry URL.
items.translation: 返回 Docker 注册表 URL。

items.source: Returns the username to use when authenticating to the Docker registry.
items.translation: 返回用于向 Docker 注册表进行身份验证的用户名。

items.source: Whether verbose logging should be enabled while building the image.
items.translation: 构建镜像时是否启用详细日志记录。

items.source: Returns the classpath that will be included in the archive.
items.translation: 返回将包含在归档中的类路径。

items.source: Returns the network the build container will connect to.
items.translation: 返回构建容器将连接的网路。
